SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CODE, VAT_RATE, CUSTOMER_SINCE FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE CUSTOMER_ID <= 6 ORDER BY CUSTOMER_ID

exec sp_executesql N'SELECT COUNT(*) AS N, MIN(ORDER_NUMBER) AS FIRST_ORDER, @CODE AS CODE, @VAT_RATE AS VAT, @CUSTOMER_SINCE AS SINCE, SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(CAST(@VAT_RATE AS SQL_VARIANT), ''BaseType'') AS VT FROM ORDERS WHERE CUSTOMER_ID = @CUSTOMER_ID AND VAT_RATE = @VAT_RATE AND ORDER_DATE >= @CUSTOMER_SINCE',N'@CUSTOMER_ID int,@CODE nvarchar(5),@VAT_RATE float,@CUSTOMER_SINCE datetime',@CUSTOMER_ID=1,@CODE=N'C0001',@VAT_RATE=21,@CUSTOMER_SINCE='2019-01-06 00:00:00'
